notes.title: energy fruit, new enemies and player now shoots upwards.
notes.content: A plant appeared, whose fruit, when eaten, gives the player more energy, increases his jump and speed, I put new enemies ... among them an immortal annoying mosquito ... and now the player shoots upwards too .. it is explained in the menu about the game. it got much more lively and game and easier to pass the levels.
